purpose: Decide whether further paid stronger-family model runs are scientifically justified before submission.

prehend_srlm_style.subject: fix: bounce guard-rejection echoes as final answers

candidates.candidate: Scale public lambda-RLM adapter to full Oolong N=120 standard contract
candidates.evidence: Public implementation adapter has 63/150 exact on label-provided Oolong and 0/15 exact on the matched standard-unlabeled smoke.
candidates.reason: The public repository is real, but the project adapter is not the lambda-RLM paper protocol. The matched smoke emitted no exact aggregate answers, so a larger run would mostly measure adapter mismatch.
candidates.required_before_scale: A benchmark-compatible lambda-RLM/Oolong protocol or a smoke that returns valid aggregate answers under the exact paper-facing contract.

candidates.candidate: Scale public prehend/SRLM-style adapter to full Oolong N=120 standard contract
candidates.evidence: prehend SRLM-style has 48/60 exact on label-provided Oolong and 7/15 exact on the standard-unlabeled smoke, tied with standard RLM but below SLM/direct on the same IDs.
candidates.reason: This is the strongest available public stronger-family pressure row, but it is not an official Apple SRLM reproduction. Scaling it could add useful context, yet would not close the official-reproduction objection.
candidates.required_before_scale: Official SRLM code/protocol, author-confirmed equivalence, or a predeclared N=15/N=30 standard smoke that clearly reverses the main SLM/direct/RLM ordering.

candidates.candidate: Scale Gemini 3.5 Flash as a current standard-RLM controller
candidates.evidence: Direct Gemini 3.5 sensitivity is 20/45 exact; the RLM prefix is 5/8 exact with 3 timeout/error rows.
candidates.reason: It addresses freshness but not stronger-family protocol fidelity, and the attempted standard-RLM prefix showed early timeout/accounting instability.
candidates.required_before_scale: A clean timeout-free controller prefix with reliable provider usage accounting and a clear claim that controller freshness, not family-method fidelity, is the target.

candidates.evidence: Sonnet 4.6 standard-RLM stop-rule probe is 0/3 exact with 1 timeout/error row and $0.049605 captured completed-row cost.
candidates.reason: A stronger controller swap would be expensive and still would not reproduce SRLM or lambda-RLM. The stop-rule probe also showed worse stability than the logged Gemini controller on matched rows.
candidates.required_before_scale: A separate manuscript claim about controller scaling plus a stable low-cost compatibility prefix; neither is currently needed for the focused audit.

candidates.candidate: Run only an official or near-official SRLM/lambda-RLM same-contract comparator
candidates.evidence: Search/source check: the lambda-RLM paper advertises the lambda-calculus-LLM/lambda-RLM implementation; SRLM surfaces as paper/Hugging Face/arXiv pages in the current search rather than an obvious official runnable Apple repository. Local repos therefore support official-public lambda adapter evidence and unofficial SRLM-style prehend pressure evidence.
candidates.reason: This is the only stronger-family spend that would materially change the rejection-risk profile. It must be faithful enough that reviewers read it as comparator parity rather than adapter debugging.
candidates.required_before_scale: Exact official/author-backed implementation, frozen Oolong standard-input contract, identical scorer, full prompt/raw-output/cost logging, and a predeclared stop rule.

gate_rule.current_result: No available paid extension clears the gate except a future official/near-official SRLM/lambda-RLM same-contract protocol.

paper_action: Keep stronger-family rows as bounded pressure checks, keep the main claim scoped to standard rlms v0.1.3, and do not spend on larger public-adapter or strong-controller runs before submission unless official/near-official protocol fidelity changes.
